basic_profile.bio: A die-hard fan of the Fallout series, I have been exploring the wastelands of Reddit for nearly a decade. Born and raised in a small town in the Midwest, I'm a software engineer by day and a gaming enthusiast by night. When I'm not busy debugging code, you can find me tinkering with old computers or strategizing my next move in a game of chess. I am currently single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking or crabbing along the coast. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually after 9 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, I've spent years honing my skills in software development. My passion for gaming led me to self-teach modding, particularly for Fallout games. I enjoy sharing my technical insights on gaming forums and helping others troubleshoot issues.
